_doc: Job file for _shared/adapters/book_summarizer_team.py. The conductor resolves the book once (PDF path, page offset, chapter page ranges) and the driver runs one book-summarizer worker per chapter on the team account. book_root is vault-relative, or absolute when the build must be isolated from the vault (the driver then grants it with --add-dir). model is a full model id: it is passed to --model and copied into the notes' agent: line as BUILDER_ID. folder is the chapter folder name the notes go under; done = <book_root>/<folder>/<chapter>.00_*.md exists with an agent: line.
pdf: /mnt/c/Users/<WINDOWS_USER>/My Drive/_WORKSPACE/40_Resources/ZoteroStorage/Torquato_2002_Random Heterogeneous Materials/Torquato - 2002 - Random Heterogeneous Materials Microstructure and Macroscopic Properties 1.pdf

chapters.scope: the whole chapter: overview note 20.00 plus one note per section
chapters.focus: strong-contrast expansions; carry every printed equation, Tables 20.1-20.2, Figures 20.1-20.3
